name: Haven Hall
accommodation: 15 rooms and suites, including a two-bedroom penthouse sleeping six; open late May to early September
suitableFor: Couples, families and dog owners wanting a luxury summer stay
parking: Parking on site with EV charging
beachAccess: Close to the beach; Shanklin Beach about 0.47 miles, roughly a 5-minute walk (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
boardStorage: Secure cycle and luggage storage (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
confirmedFeatures: Swimming pool, tennis court, croquet lawn, continental breakfast, bar, EV charging
overview: Haven Hall is a boutique hotel on Howard Road in Shanklin, about a five-minute walk from the beach. It opens for the summer season only, with 15 rooms and suites including a two-bedroom penthouse, and has a heated outdoor pool, a grass tennis court and gated parking. Three ground-floor rooms take dogs.
surfTripFit: A summer-only base within walking distance of Shanklin Beach, with secure storage and parking. It is closed outside the season.
